faq.q: What services does Grid Nova Energy offer?
faq.a: We offer five core services: Solar EPC (end-to-end engineering, procurement and construction), Green Energy Projects for residential, commercial and industrial clients, Grid-Scale Solar Infrastructure for utility-scale plants, Operation & Maintenance, and Energy Consulting including feasibility studies and full DISCOM support.

faq.q: Do you help with PM Surya Ghar subsidy paperwork?
faq.a: Yes — our residential scope includes full PM Surya Ghar subsidy documentation, net-metering DISCOM applications, structural load assessment, and long-term performance support.

faq.q: Do you install solar pumps under PM-KUSUM?
faq.a: Yes. Agricultural solar pumps deployed under the Prime Minister's Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan (PM-KUSUM) scheme are part of our government & institutional delivery.

Four segments: Residential (homeowners & housing societies), Commercial (offices, hospitals, hotels, campuses), Industrial (manufacturing & processing facilities), and Government & Institutional (schools, municipal infrastructure, public-sector facilities).

faq.q: Do you offer maintenance after installation?
faq.a: Yes — every system includes preventive and corrective Operation & Maintenance to protect performance for the life of the installation. Our commitment doesn't end at commissioning.

faq.q: What's Grid Nova Energy's track record?
faq.a: Our leadership team and affiliated branches have collectively delivered 4,800+ street lamps, 330+ 10kW WBREDA schools, 2,350+ PM-KUSUM solar pumps, and 1,200+ PM Surya Ghar residential installations across West Bengal and Bihar.

residential.label: Residential
residential.alt: Grid Nova technician showing a homeowner the rooftop solar inverter after installation
residential.heading: Energy independence for homeowners and housing societies.
residential.body: We design and install rooftop solar systems for individual homeowners and multi-unit housing societies seeking to reduce electricity bills and gain independence from grid tariff volatility. Our residential scope includes full PM Surya Ghar subsidy documentation, net-metering DISCOM application and post-installation performance support.

commercial.label: Commercial
commercial.alt: Grid Nova technicians wiring rooftop solar panels across a dense commercial building complex
commercial.heading: Reducing operating costs for offices, hospitals and institutions.
commercial.body: Commercial buildings typically run high daytime loads that align closely with peak solar generation hours — making rooftop and carport solar installations financially compelling within 3–5 year payback windows. We handle the full process from energy audit and system design through procurement, installation and ongoing O&M.
commercial.body2: Clients include office campuses, hospitals, hotels and educational institutions across West Bengal and beyond.

industrial.label: Industrial
industrial.alt: Grid Nova technicians inspecting an electrical enclosure on an industrial warehouse rooftop solar installation
industrial.heading: Reducing energy costs and improving sustainability metrics.
industrial.body: Manufacturing plants, warehouses and processing facilities carry high, consistent power loads — exactly the profile where large rooftop or ground-mount solar delivers maximum financial return. We work directly with plant engineering teams to minimise production disruption during installation and ensure the system integrates cleanly with existing power management infrastructure.
industrial.body2: The 1.3 MWp EPC project delivered by Grid Nova’s team and branch network for Showa India in Faridabad is the clearest demonstration of that industrial execution capability — a full-scale delivery managed across design, procurement, construction and commissioning phases.
industrial.link: See the Showa India case study

government.label: Government & Institutional
government.heading: Public projects aligned with national renewable energy targets.
government.body: Grid Nova’s team and branch network brings extensive experience executing projects under national government solar programmes — including the electrification of 330+ 10kW schools for WBREDA, 2,350+ agricultural pump installations under PM-KUSUM, and 4,800+ solar street lamps across rural districts. Government projects demand rigorous compliance documentation, transparent procurement and proven execution capacity. We have the track record.

michael-gomes.bio: Michael Gomes is an accomplished, dynamic serial entrepreneur and strong visionary with out-of-the-box thinking and a passion for building impactful businesses. A proven go-getter and inspirational leader, he is building a diversified conglomerate and has successfully led large-scale EPC businesses with year-on-year substantial growth. He brings together deep experience across marketing leadership, international relations, digital business, trade, and EPC project execution.

shouvik-biswas.bio: As Partner at GRID NOVA ENERGY, Shouvik Biswas focuses on strategy, finance and growth, bringing a disciplined commercial and investment perspective to the company. He works closely with the leadership team on capital allocation, project evaluation, financial controls, strategic partnerships and expansion into new markets. His focus is on developing GRID NOVA ENERGY as a professionally managed, financially disciplined and scalable renewable-energy enterprise with strong foundations for long-term growth.

raju-paul.bio: Mr. Raju Paul is a business strategist with over 25 years of experience translating market insight into structured, executable growth plans — a career that has evolved from strategic marketing into full-spectrum business strategy formation. A certified project management specialist with an advanced credential from IIT Roorkee, and an MBA and MSc in Economics from IIM Calcutta, he pairs rigorous analytical grounding with hands-on delivery discipline. As Grid Nova Energy's business growth strategist, Mr. Paul works closely with the leadership team to align commercial ambition with operational execution, steering expansion into new markets and segments through the same disciplined, results-driven approach that has defined his career.

srinjay-das.bio: Srinjay Das is a veteran professional with strong analytical and technical abilities and 25+ years of experience in international business and managing key accounts. His competency in EPC, project management and construction management is a core organisational asset, backed by exceptional negotiation skills and deep knowledge of the Indian market.

moloy-das.bio: A seasoned graduate engineer with 20 years of experience in planning and project management, Moloy Das has executed large-scale infrastructure, turnkey mechanical and solar energy projects across India — the operational backbone of Grid Nova's project delivery engine.

arun-kumar.bio: Arun Kumar is a dynamic, results-oriented sales professional with over three decades of experience in the solar and renewable energy sector, with a proven record securing utility-scale, commercial, industrial and government solar EPC contracts across India.

naren-mukherjee.bio: Mr. Naren Mukherjee brings 30 years of Information Technology experience across hardware, software and customer engineering support, most recently as Eastern Regional Support Head at Spice Net Ltd. An Electrical Engineer by profession, he steered PCL to India's first ISO 9002 certification for IT support services, and was recognised as Intel Corporation's Best IT Professional of Asia in 1998. Since 2009, he has brought that same engineering discipline to solar power, supervising the installation of more than 25 MWp of solar capacity across India.

sustainabilityPage.beliefTitle: We view each project as infrastructure, not a transaction.
sustainabilityPage.beliefBody: The solar systems we install will generate clean power for 25 years or more. The decisions made during design, procurement and installation — component quality, structural integrity, protection coordination — determine whether that 25-year promise is kept or quietly broken within the first decade.
sustainabilityPage.beliefBody2: We engineer projects as long-term energy infrastructure, not as short-cycle installations optimised for installation day metrics. Every commissioning test, every warranty decision, every procurement specification reflects that position.
sustainabilityPage.commitmentTitle: Our commitment to India’s clean energy future.
sustainabilityPage.commitmentBody: India’s national renewable energy targets are ambitious, and meeting them requires execution at volume across every segment — residential, commercial, industrial and government. Grid Nova Energy positions itself as the delivery partner that can execute at that volume without compromising on the engineering standards that determine whether those targets translate to actual, sustained clean generation.
sustainabilityPage.commitmentBody2: We do not view sustainability as a communications exercise. We view it as the primary measure of whether a solar installation was worth building in the first place.

technology.title: Engineering standards, not shortcuts.
technology.intro: Every Grid Nova project follows the same six-stage engineering process — documented, supervised and signed off at each transition.

steps.title: Feasibility Analysis
steps.body: Before any design work begins, we assess the site on every relevant dimension: solar irradiance data, shadow-casting obstructions, structural condition of the mounting surface, proximity to the grid interconnection point, and financial inputs for payback modelling. A feasibility study that misses one of these dimensions can invalidate a project post-construction.

steps.title: System Design
steps.body: We develop the complete electrical design package: module layout optimised for available surface area and shadow avoidance, string grouping, inverter selection, DC cable sizing and routing, AC switchgear specification, single-line diagram and protection coordination. All designs are developed using industry-standard engineering simulation software to validate yield projections against actual site inputs.

steps.title: Procurement
steps.body: We source high-efficiency solar PV modules from reputed, certified manufacturers with proven performance data and bankable warranties. Inverters, mounting structures, cables, protection devices and balance-of-system components are procured against pre-agreed specifications — no substitutions without client sign-off. Robust vendor relationships ensure consistent quality and timely supply, even on multi-site government programmes.

steps.title: Construction
steps.body: Civil works, mounting structure installation, module racking, wiring and conduit installation are all executed to documented quality standards. Our site teams are supervised by experienced project engineers who enforce compliance with both our internal standards and applicable electrical safety regulations. Progress is documented photographically at every major milestone.

steps.title: Commissioning
steps.body: Before handover, every system undergoes a structured commissioning protocol: insulation resistance tests, IV curve checks on each string, inverter functional testing, protection relay verification and DISCOM synchronisation check. Systems are only handed over with a complete test report and operating manual. We don't commission against a deadline — we commission against a standard.

steps.title: Operation & Maintenance
steps.body: Commissioning is the beginning, not the end. We offer structured O&M programmes that include scheduled preventive maintenance, corrective fault response, thermographic inspection, string performance analysis and yield reporting. Degradation is tracked against modelled projections, and any underperformance is investigated and addressed — not noted and ignored.

standards: High-efficiency solar PV modules sourced from certified manufacturers with BIS/IEC certifications.
Advanced inverters meeting international performance benchmarks and DISCOM interconnection requirements.
System design validated using industry-standard engineering software tools for yield simulation and shadow analysis.
Full compliance with MNRE guidelines, Central Electricity Authority regulations and applicable state DISCOM interconnection standards.

intro.title: Full-lifecycle capability.
intro.body: Grid Nova delivers every service below in-house — not subcontracted, not templated. Each engagement is engineered for the specific site, client and budget.

epc.label: 01 / EPC
epc.title: Solar EPC Services
epc.body: We manage the full Engineering, Procurement and Construction lifecycle for grid-connected and off-grid solar power plants. From initial site survey through system design, equipment sourcing, civil works, module installation, cabling, inverter commissioning and DISCOM grid synchronisation — every activity sits under one accountable contract.
epc.body2: Our EPC scope includes technical due diligence, shadow analysis, structural loading assessment, protection relay coordination, and documentation packages for state electricity regulatory body approvals. We do not begin construction until the design is signed off in full.
epc.alt: Grid Nova Energy Solar EPC — large-scale installation

green.label: 02 / Green Energy
green.title: Green Energy Projects
green.alt: Green Energy Project — distributed solar installation, Grid Nova Energy
green.body: We design and install solar systems precisely matched to each building’s load profile, roof geometry, structural capacity and grid-interconnection point. Residential, commercial and industrial profiles each demand different engineering assumptions — we model every one specifically.
green.body2: Our delivery includes net-metering applications, DISCOM approval management, roof waterproofing assessment and post-installation performance monitoring. We handle PM Surya Ghar subsidy documentation for eligible residential customers — a process that requires careful coordination between the installer, DISCOM and the national portal.

gridScale.label: 03 / Grid-Scale
gridScale.title: Grid-Scale Solar Infrastructure
gridScale.alt: Utility-scale ground-mounted solar farm — Grid Nova Energy
gridScale.body: For large ground-mounted installations, we provide design and execution support covering land suitability, irradiance modelling, single-line diagram development, inverter and transformer specification, substation design, grid evacuation planning and full project management through commissioning.
gridScale.body2: Grid Nova’s team and branch network has delivered projects aligned with PM-KUSUM component C — 2,350+ solar pump installations across rural districts in Bihar and West Bengal — representing large-scale rural deployment capability under government programme constraints.

government.label: 04 / Government Programmes
government.title: Government &
government.body: Grid Nova’s branch network has delivered at scale under national and state electrification programmes — work that demands rigorous compliance, documentation and on-ground execution across rural districts.

items.d: Grid-connected rooftop solar for schools and public institutions, delivered to government programme quality and documentation standards — including 330+ schools electrified for WBREDA.

Standalone solar street lighting — pole, module, battery and controller — supplied, installed and commissioned under state and central government rural electrification programmes. 4,800+ units deployed.
Solarisation of agricultural pump sets under PM-KUSUM Component C, replacing diesel and grid-dependent irrigation with solar-powered pumping. 2,350+ installations completed.

om.label: 05 / O&M
om.title: Operation &
om.body: A solar system performs precisely as well as it is maintained. Our O&M programmes are structured around the principle that annual yield degradation is a management problem, not an inevitability.

items.d: Scheduled cleaning, thermographic inspection, string performance checks and inverter health monitoring.
Fault diagnosis, component replacement and root-cause documentation within defined response windows.
Yield analysis against modelled generation, PR ratio tracking and degradation benchmarking.
DISCOM compliance documentation, safety inspection records and warranty claim management.

consulting.label: 06 / Consulting
consulting.title: Energy Consulting
consulting.body: Not every client needs a full EPC contract from day one. Our consulting scope is available as a standalone engagement for clients who need rigorous technical input before committing to a project.

items.d: Solar resource assessment, yield projection, financial modelling and payback analysis using site-specific inputs.
Shadow analysis, structural survey, grid interconnection capacity check and civil condition review.
Full electrical design package: module string layout, inverter selection, single-line diagram and protection coordination.
DISCOM interconnection applications, net-metering documentation, MNRE subsidy processing and state nodal agency coordination.

ahead.label: 07 / Looking Ahead
ahead.body: As India’s energy needs evolve, we’re developing capability in battery energy storage (BESS), EV charging infrastructure and microgrid solutions — natural extensions of our core solar EPC expertise. These are emerging areas for Grid Nova, not offerings available today, and we’ll formally bring them to market as that capability matures.

journey.title: From your first call to your subsidy — eight steps.
journey.intro: This is the path every rooftop system follows with us. You will always know which step you are on.

steps.title: Enquiry
steps.body: You call, message or fill in a form. We ask about your roof and your electricity bill.

steps.title: Site survey
steps.body: Our engineer visits, checks the roof, shade and wiring, and takes photographs.

steps.title: Proposal
steps.body: You receive a written proposal with the system size, equipment and price.

steps.title: Agreement
steps.body: You accept the proposal and sign the agreement, including any agreement the scheme requires.

steps.title: Installation
steps.body: Our team installs the panels, inverter and wiring, and records every serial number.

steps.title: DISCOM inspection & net meter
steps.body: Your electricity company inspects the system and fits the net meter.

steps.title: Commissioning
steps.body: We test the system, switch it on and hand over the test report and manual.

steps.title: Subsidy
steps.body: If you applied under PM Surya Ghar, we follow up the subsidy on the national portal until it is credited.

journey.note: The subsidy is paid by the Government. Its approval, amount and timing are decided by the scheme, not by Grid Nova.

programme.noFee: Grid Nova does not charge any registration fee, joining fee or security deposit. If anyone asks you for money to join, report it to us.

programmes.name: Associate
programmes.tagline: For individuals who know people who want solar.
points: Sales Associate — find and introduce customers, collect their information and documents, and hand them to Grid Nova. Grid Nova does the site assessment, proposal, installation and completion.

Execution Associate — also manage the project stages Grid Nova assigns to you: site assessment, document collection, installation coordination, recording the installed equipment, and follow-up to completion.
You choose one when you register; Grid Nova approves it.

programmes.name: Preferred Associate
programmes.tagline: For established people appointed to a territory.
points: Appointed to a territory and level: State Head (at most two per state), District Head (one per district) or Block Associate.
Introduce customers and carry out the project stages assigned to you, to the same standards as an Execution Associate.
Support the Associates in your territory and recommend new applicants — Grid Nova makes the final decision.
Earn commission on your own customers plus a territory commission on verified business in your territory.

eligibility: You are at least 18 years old and live in India.
You have a bank account in your own name.
You agree to a verification phone call before approval.
docs: Aadhaar — a masked copy showing only the last four digits (you can download it from UIDAI)
Bank account details and a cancelled cheque
programme.earningsTitle: How earnings work, in plain words
earnings: You earn only when a customer’s payment has reached Grid Nova’s bank account and been checked. A payment that is only promised earns nothing.
You earn in step with the payment: if the customer has paid part of the price, you earn on that part.
Each entry in your portal moves from Earned to Approved to Paid, and shows which customer and which payment it belongs to.
Approved commission is paid into a bank account in your own name, [monthly, by the 10th of the following month].
Tax is deducted at source as the law requires, and you receive TDS certificates.
If a payment is reversed — a cheque bounces, a refund is made, a project is cancelled — the commission on it is reversed too.
programme.earningsNote: Commission rates for each programme and level are shown in your portal, not on this page.

howItWorks.intro: A walkthrough of the Associate portal. The screens below are illustrations of how it will work, not the live portal.

steps.body: Once approved you receive a unique Associate ID, a digital ID card and welcome letter, and a physical welcome kit. Your ID card carries a QR code anyone can scan to confirm you.

guidelines.title: How every Grid Nova Associate works.

items.title: No cash, ever
items.body: Customers pay only into Grid Nova’s own bank account — by cheque, demand draft, NEFT, RTGS, IMPS or UPI. Never accept cash, and never let a customer pay you or any other account.

items.title: No price promises
items.body: Don’t promise a price, discount, subsidy, approval, timeline or warranty that Grid Nova hasn’t confirmed in writing.

items.title: Approved brands only
items.body: Recommend only the equipment, brands and categories Grid Nova has approved.

items.title: Customer data stays in the portal
items.body: Collect details in person, explain why using the Customer Information Notice, and never copy customer information outside the portal.

photoTips: Take them on site, through the portal camera — never upload photos from another site or from the internet.
Shoot in daylight. First the whole roof in one frame, then close-ups.
Show everything that can cast shade: water tanks, walls, trees, towers, nearby buildings.
Photograph the electricity meter and the main distribution board.
Keep them sharp and unedited — no filters, no screenshots.
guidelines.portalTitle: Helping a customer approve the agreement on the PM Surya Ghar portal
portalSteps: The customer signs in to the national PM Surya Ghar portal with their own login.
Together, check that Grid Nova is shown as the vendor and that the details match the customer’s proposal.
The customer approves the agreement themselves.
Never ask for the customer’s password or OTP, and never approve on their behalf.
guidelines.portalNote: Portal screens can change. Always follow the steps the portal itself shows.

faq.title: Associate FAQ

items.q: Is there a fee to join?
items.a: No. Grid Nova does not charge any registration fee, joining fee or security deposit. If anyone asks you for money to join, report it to us.

items.q: Will I be a Grid Nova employee?
items.a: No. Associates are independent and work on their own account. You cannot sign contracts, quote prices or accept money on Grid Nova’s behalf.
Commission is earned when the customer’s payment is verified in Grid Nova’s bank account. After Grid Nova approves it, it is paid to your bank account [monthly, by the 10th of the following month].

items.q: How will customers know I am genuine?
items.a: Your Grid Nova ID card carries a QR code. Anyone can scan it to confirm your name, photo, ID, level and active status.

items.q: What if two Associates bring the same customer?
items.a: The customer belongs to the first Associate whose complete submission Grid Nova verifies. It stays with that Associate for [90] days, or until the project is completed or closed.

items.q: Can I stop being an Associate?
items.a: Yes, with [15] days’ written notice through your portal. Commission already earned on verified payments remains payable.

jobs.thrive2: You’re comfortable in the field as much as in a spreadsheet. You know that DISCOM processes and MNRE compliance aren’t bureaucratic nuisances — they’re the job.
